messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Rivera <ops-eng@acme.com>, Anika Shah <cto@scalegrid.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: traffic replay / load window confirmation & capacity asks

Hi Tom / Anika —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our mutual action plan (attached updated MAP v2), next milestone is the load/performance test where we run a traffic replay for your checkout flows and a targeted peak QPS stress window. I wanted to capture the items we agreed and call out a few open asks so we can lock scheduling this week.

Recap / proposed milestone items:
- Target objective: validate 95th pct latency <= 350ms and observe cost/per-token at peak workload.
- Replay scope: cart checkout, promo-code path, guest checkout; estimated 30k unique sessions over 3 hours.
- Peak windows: we discussed either 2h contiguous peak or three 30-min peaks spread across day; you preferred a single contiguous evening window (see options below).
- Redwood responsibilities: supply traffic-replay harness, pre-warm KV cache, provide Dedicated sizing recommendation and runbook.
- Acme responsibilities: provide production-ish sample logs, allow a read-only replay account/IPs, confirm allowed test windows and whether we can operate on your staging or shadow environment.

Open asks (need answers to schedule):
1) Confirm preferred test window (A: Thu 2026-08-19 22:00-00:00 PDT, B: Mon 2026-08-23 02:00-04:00 PDT).
2) Share sanitized session logs and a small sample (we got the initial S3 pointer but need the replay-ready CSV).
3) Confirm whether Acme can allocate a dedicated subnet for the replay or prefer Redwood to run from our Dedicated pool targeting your region. If the latter, we will propose GPU pool sizes but need expected sustained QPS.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx (MAP milestones + responsibilities), traffic-replay-windows.csv (proposed replay segmentation).

Next steps/ask: please reply with the window choice and attach a pointer to the sample logs by EOD Wed 2026-08-11 so we can reserve Dedicated capacity. If you'd like, Karthik and I can run a 30-min pre-check next Tue to validate the harness on a small sample.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: traffic replay / load window confirmation & capacity asks

Laura —

Thanks for the clear summary. We're aligned on objectives. Quick answers inline: 

1) Window: we prefer Option A (Thu 2026-08-19 22:00-00:00 PDT). That maps to our lower-traffic maintenance slot and gives us daylight for follow-up on Friday.
2) Logs: I'll drop a sanitized sample to the Drive link before EOD Wed (I flagged PII and removed tokens). Expect ~2k session records for the sample.
3) Network: we cannot carve a subnet this month; please plan to run from Redwood Dedicated in us-west-2 and we'll open the ACLs for the replay IP range.

Capacity/expected QPS: production peak is ~6.5k QPS sustained for ~12 minutes during big promos; for the checkout flow the peak sustained QPS on the critical path is ~1.2k. For the replay scope we estimate an average of 400-600 QPS with short spikes to 1.5k. If you run a 2h contiguous test with warm cache we expect sustained ~500 QPS.

Note: Our security team asked for an IP allowlist doc and a short statement about what data the replay harness captures — can you provide both?

Tom
Tom Rivera
Head of Platform Operations, Acme Retail
ops-eng@acme.com

Subject: Re: MAP: traffic replay / load window confirmation & capacity asks

Tom — excellent, thanks for the fast turnaround and the QPS detail, that's very helpful. Two quick replies and a concrete proposal below.

Security/ops deliverables:
- IP allowlist doc: attached (IP_ALLOWLIST_v1.pdf stub) — includes the Redwood egress IP blocks for the planned Dedicated pool.
- Data capture statement: The replay harness samples request paths and timing metadata only; we do not capture full payment tokens, PII is redacted in the sample. We'll include a one-page SOW paragraph for procurement.

Dedicated sizing proposal (prelim):
- For a contiguous 2h replay with sustained 500 QPS and spikes to 1.5k, we recommend a 4-GPU Dedicated pool (A100-equivalent or 4xH100-variant quantized profile) with autoscale headroom for spikes.
- If Acme needs a lower committed spend, we can run with a 2-GPU baseline and add burst capacity; this will increase peak latency risk.

MAP milestone (scheduling & responsibilities) — proposed finalization for the MAP: 
- Milestone name: Load/Traffic Replay — execution
- Target date: 2026-08-19 22:00-00:00 PDT
- Redwood owner: Laura Bennett (engineer: Karthik Iyer) — prep, harness, run, results analysis
- Acme owner: Tom Rivera (security: Anika Shah) — provide logs, open ACLs, review runbook
- Dependencies: sample logs uploaded by 2026-08-11, signed replay SOW by 2026-08-13, Dedicated pool reservation by 2026-08-16
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency <= 350ms OR documented regression with recommended remediation plan

Action items for closure this week:
- Tom: post sample logs to Drive and confirm ACL window by EOD Wed 2026-08-11.
- Acme procurement: review attached SOW paragraph and confirm redlines by Fri 2026-08-13.
- Karthik/Redwood infra: I'll put a capacity reservation request in for the 4-GPU pool pending your confirmation; Karthik can run a 30-min precheck Tue 2026-08-17.

If this looks good I'll update the MAP spreadsheet and move the milestone to "Committed".

Thanks — Laura

Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
